sara (PM): Kickoff: we need to finalize pilot scope for the Optimize toolkit features: eval-triggered alerts, tenant opt-in, and quantization recommendations. ACME flagged this as high priority.

jas (Sales): ACME wants predictable ops impact and clear rollback. They asked if quant recs can be previewed in staging first and want a contract clause that auto-opts them out of automated changes.

miguel (CS): From CS: must have per-tenant audit logs and an "apply" approval flow. Also request daily digest email in addition to webhooks so their SREs don't miss something.

anika (ML): ML POV: need to pick a primary signal. I suggest "concordance_p95" for high-precision detection and a secondary signal for hallucination_rate_top20. We should characterize false-positive rate on each signal before gating.

kai (Eng): Implementation constraints: split into Alerting infra (ingest, detect, deliver) and Recs infra (simulate quant profiles, run A/B sims). Storage for eval traces is the biggest cost. Proposal: keep compressed deltas 90 days, full traces 30 days.

sara (PM): Proposed pilot acceptance criteria (draft):
- Coverage: pilot with internal + 2 alpha tenants.
- Alert quality: precision >= 80% on top-50 customer prompts over pilot window.
- Quant recs: when applied by customers, quality delta < 1% in >= 90% of cases.
- Operational: TTD median < 7 days; webhook delivery success >= 99% (with retries).

jas (Sales): Suggest we make the precision bar configurable per customer; ACME might take lower precision with human review. Also they want SLA language around webhook latency.

anika (ML): For quant scoring I'm proposing a normalized score: score = (quality_delta_pct * 100) - (latency_improve_ms/100) - (cost_saving_pct). Recommend when score <= 2.0. We'll validate weights in sims.

kai (Eng): Deployment model: feature-flagged rollout in three phases: internal canary -> alpha tenants -> open pilot. For GA, recommendations visible in Console + Apply API (requires tenant admin approval). No automatic apply for hosted GA.

miguel (CS): Data consent: CS will prepare opt-in language and list required fields for telemetry. Alpha customers must sign off. Also: audit trail retention policy needed for legal.

sara (PM): Risks: 1) noisy alerts causing pager fatigue; 2) storage cost; 3) customer mistrust if recs degrade quality. Mitigations: tune thresholds per tenant, sampling, human-in-loop apply for GA, and clear revert actions.

kai (Eng): Action items: create two epics (alert infra, recs simulation + UI). Estimate rough sizing next day. Set rate-limits on webhook retries and paging backoff.

anika (ML): Action items: run backtests on last 12 months for 6 customers, produce ROC curve and suggested thresholds, publish scoring formula and sample sims by EOW.

miguel (CS): Action: recruit two alpha customers (ACME + one smaller customer), get opt-in, provide webhook endpoints. Draft admin consent language.

ops-bot: Feature flag created: ff/optimize-eval-alerts-2026 on branch feat/optimize-eval. Staging env provisioned. CI job started. :white_check_mark:

sara (PM): I'll write a one-pager PRD with the gates above and tag owners. Please post weekly status updates in this thread. If anyone wants a different precision/TTD gate, raise it now.
